We offer a broad range of analyses, reports and market insights designed to support businesses, investors and private individuals in making informed financial decisions.

Our reports include insights into global economic forecasts, sustainable finance and capital markets, as well as indicators tracking housing prices and savings behaviour. The reports are complemented by expert commentary, investment information and current opportunities within the financial markets.

Our reports and publications

Nordic Outlook

After a turbulent summer, hopes rose with the Iran-US ceasefire and peace talks, raising expectations of stability and a reopened Hormuz Strait. Read our economists' in-depth theme articles and analysis in the latest edition of Nordic Outlook.

Investment Outlook

In this report, you will find SEB’s current market outlook – from the overarching macroeconomic factors to our assessment of the equity and fixed income markets.

Sustainable Finance Outlook

Our Sustainable Finance Outlook report offers insights and market intelligence to navigate the sustainability transition. It provides regular updates on energy transition investments, sustainable finance markets, regulations, and topical research.

Företagarindikatorn (Swe)

In SEB's Företagarindikatorn, sole traders share their monthly views on trends in turnover, liquidity and working hours, as well as their expectations for the future.

Annual reports

Our Annual report summarises SEB’s achievements, financial performance, and sustainability efforts from the past year, with the sustainability statement integrated in the report.

Interim reports

Access Interim reports, fact books, fact book figures, result presentations, audio webcasts and telephone conferences as well as investor presentations for each quarter.

Reports and indicators on household finances

Sparkollen (Swe)

Sparkollen shows whether households plan to increase or decrease their savings over the next six months, how much they save each month, and where they invest their money.

Sparbarometern (Swe)

Sparbarometern provides a quarterly overview of household wealth and debt.

Boprisindikatorn (Swe)

Boprisindikatorn shows each month the public’s view of how house and condominium prices, as well as the policy rate, are expected to develop.

Frequently asked questions about our reports and publications

You can find SEB’s latest financial results in our Interim Reports section, linked from the reports and publications page. Here, you can access interim reports, presentations and other financial updates published by SEB.

Historical SEB reports are available through the reports and publications page, where you can browse archived annual reports, sustainability reports and earlier financial publications. SEB provides access to reports dating back several years, including annual reports from previous decades.

SEB’s sustainability reporting is integrated into the Annual Report and prepared in accordance with applicable reporting frameworks and regulations. Parts of the sustainability disclosures are subject to external assurance as part of the Annual report audit process. For details on the scope of assurance, please refer to the auditor’s report included in the relevant Annual and Sustainability report.

SEB provides a wide range of reports and publications. Such as our Annual and Interim reports, Sustainability reports and prospectuses. Visitors can also access market insights such as Nordic Outlook, Investment Outlook and Sustainable Finance Outlook reports.

Yes, SEB reports and publications are available to download in PDF format. This includes annual reports, interim reports, sustainability reporting, presentations and other financial publications, making it easy to access information online or offline.

SEB publishes financial reports on a regular basis throughout the year, including quarterly interim reports and an annual report. These reports provide updates on SEB’s financial performance, business development, sustainability progress and risk management.
